hooks.name: Update project report on source change
hooks.description: When contract or web source changes, reminds the agent to check whether docs/PROJECT-REPORT.md needs updating (features, stack, scope, change log).

action.prompt: A source or dependency file changed. Check whether docs/PROJECT-REPORT.md needs updating: features table (§4), tech stack and versions (§3), scope (§5), and the change log (§9). If this change adds/removes/alters a feature, changes the stack, or shifts scope, update PROJECT-REPORT.md in the same change and add a dated row to the §9 change log. If the change is cosmetic (formatting, comments), no report update is needed.
